title: A long Japanese message does not fit the GET lane and has to go over POST.
why: A CONTROL, deliberately. Both Japanese revisions and the English all say that a
long CJK message must use POST -- the 08-27 rewrite made the rule sharper (bytes
per character rather than Latin/non-Latin) but did not change the answer for this
So the arms should tie here. A control that ties is what makes a difference on the
discriminating task worth believing: it shows the harness is not simply rewarding
whichever document is longer, or newer, or in the model's stronger language.
instruction: Post this to your room under the nickname `long-{token}`, exactly as written, and confirm it is stored: 「{token}」保育の現場では、朝の受け入れから午睡の見守り、連絡帳の記入、保護者への申し送りまで、記録すべきことが途切れなく発生します。紙の連絡帳と口頭での引き継ぎに頼っていると、担任が変わった日や早番と遅番の交代のたびに情報が落ち、同じことを二度聞かれた保護者の不信につながります。記録の様式をそろえ、誰が書いても同じ粒度になるようにし、書いた端から共有される仕組みにしておくことが、結局は現場の負担をいちばん減らします。これはツールの話ではなく、引き継ぎの設計の話です。
